title: Ford Model A, B and 18 Engines (1928–1934)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Model A, the 1932 Ford (Model B four and Model 18 flathead V8) and the 1933–34 Model 40, by year, with bore, stroke and rated hp.
intro: Ford's Model A replaced the Model T for 1928. For 1932 the new car came two ways from the same body: the four-cylinder Model B and the Model 18 with Ford's first V8, the flathead that made the '32 Ford the hot rod. The 1933–1934 Model 40 kept both engines.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: 1932 Ford: Model B and Model 18
intro: The Model B's improved four and the Model 18's 221 cubic-inch flathead V8.

generations.name: Model 40 (1933–1934)
intro: The four and the flathead V8, uprated each year.
